name: Generated Reason 3 Code
definition: Specifies the reason why the transaction was generated.

COLL.name: Collateral Management
COLL.definition: Transaction has been generated for collateral management purposes.

CLAI.name: Market Claim
CLAI.definition: Transaction resulting from a market claim.

RODE.name: Return Refused Dumps
RODE.definition: Relates to the return of financial instruments resulting from a rejected delivery without matching operation.

SPLI.name: Split Shaping
SPLI.definition: Transaction has been generated to enable settlement following a shortage of position.

THRD.name: Third Party
THRD.definition: Transaction has been generated by a third party, for example, a central counterparty.

TRAN.name: Transformation
TRAN.definition: Transaction has been generated due to transformation following a corporate action.
